> [!IMPORTANT]
> Bug reports for this module are handled by **Ryuki**, the original developer. Send your report by private message to [@reiryuki](https://t.me/reiryuki) on Telegram. Reports sent to the group are ignored, and `.zip` files there are deleted automatically.

Every device and ROM is different, so Ryuki needs real data to find the problem. Reports without the files below won't be looked at.

## Before reporting

- Use the **latest version** of the module. If the latest is an alpha or beta, use that.
- Check the **Known Issues** in the README. Don't report those.
- Follow the installation guide exactly.
- Disable every other module except this one and any core modules.
- One module per report.

If your device is stuck in a bootloop, rebooting on its own, or booting to recovery, follow the bootloop guide instead: https://t.me/ryukinotes/45

## Checklist

- [ ] **Explanation:** what's not working, and what you expected
- [ ] **Module install log** from Magisk/KernelSU/APatch (the *install* log, not the Magisk log). How to: https://t.me/ryukinotes/72
- [ ] **Other modules disabled** (except this one and core modules)
- [ ] **Full logcat.** How to: https://t.me/ryukinotes/73
- [ ] **Z folder.** How to: https://t.me/ryukinotes/57
- [ ] **KernelSU users:** screenshots of your full superuser list
- [ ] **Sent by private message** to [@reiryuki](https://t.me/reiryuki)

## Rules

- Missing files means no fix and no answer. Repeatedly reporting without them gets warnings.
- Reports about old versions get warnings.
- 3 warnings in the group means a mute. 3 warnings in DMs means a block.
- Ryuki is one person handling a lot of reports, so be patient.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Again: this report goes to **Ryuki** at [@reiryuki](https://t.me/reiryuki) on Telegram, not to this repository.
